__NOTOC__ {{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|yield=8 slices|time=Prep: 45 minutes (including crust)
Baking: 1 hour|difficulty=3}} {{recipe}} | [[:Category:Rhubarb recipes|Rhubarb Recipes]] | [[:Category:Strawberry recipes|Strawberry Recipes]] ==Ingredients== * 1 [[Cookbook:Flaky Pie Crust|flaky pie crust]] * 2½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (about 1¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]]) [[Cookbook:Rhubarb|rhubarb]] stalk chunks * 2½ cups [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]] * 1¼ cups white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] * ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]] or [[Cookbook:Tapioca Pearls|tapioca pearls]] * ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] ==Procedure== ===Crust=== # Prepare the [[Cookbook:Flaky Pie Crust|flaky pie crust]] and refrigerate while preparing the filling. ===Filling=== # Clean the strawberries and remove the leaves. # Cut the strawberries in halves (or quarters for larger berries). # Clean and trim the rhubarb stalks. # Cut the stalks into ½–1 inch sections. # Add sugar, cornstarch or tapioca, and salt. # Stir until rhubarb is evenly coated with dry ingredients. ===Forming the pie=== # Follow the instructions in the [[Cookbook:Flaky_Pie_Crust#To_Form_a_Covered_Pie|flaky pie crust]] recipe. == Gallery == File:01-rhubarb stalks.jpg|Storebought rhubarb stalks File:02-cleaned rhubarb stalks.jpg|Cleaned rhubarb stalks File:03-cut strawberries.jpg|Strawberries cut for pie File:04-rhubarb and strawberries.jpg|Filling for two pies File:05-filling ingredients.jpg|Dry ingredients for filling File:06-filling mixed.jpg|Mixed fruit and dry ingredients for pie filling File:17-crust filled.jpg|Crust filled with strawberries and rhubarb [[Category:Recipes for pies and tarts]] [[Category:Recipes using rhubarb]] [[Category:Recipes using strawberry]] [[Category:Vegan recipes]] [[Category:Recipes for dessert]] [[Category:Recipes using white sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using cornstarch]]
